description: Code for the paper 'Mechanistic Interpretability of Antibody Language Models Using SAEs' (manuscript BIOINF-2026-1349). It trains TopK, Batch TopK and Ordered sparse autoencoders on the antibody language models p-IgGen, IgLM and ProGen2-OAS, identifies latents for heavy J genes and other antibody properties, runs the J-gene steering benchmark (highest-F1, baseline and output-selected latents), output-selected steering of CDRH3 properties and developability metrics, ablation and joint steering, and the generation-quality metrics, and regenerates the manuscript's tables and figures. The data (SAE weights, datasets, result tables and steered libraries) are deposited with an archived snapshot of this code at doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23769036.
notes: Third-party models and tools (p-IgGen, IgLM, ProGen2, ANARCI, FlashTAP, AbLang-2, ESM-2) are not included; see docs/third_party.md.
